geometry_bands.source_anchor: at-target melee slam; immediate AoE hit covers the base area, then after a short delay an aftershock fires a LARGER-radius second hit at the same location (150% more damage). PHYSICAL RULE: physical melee -> element-neutral (element carries flavor only); identity via geometry (ground_slam = slam/quake, §6) + stun (heavy physical slam). The delayed aftershock is a native `delayed` timing primitive (delay_seconds)

mapping.deviation_notes: The plant-and-payoff delayed-aftershock slam lands well: ground_slam + native `delayed` timing (delay_seconds, engine-verified) whose non-stacking single-delayed-hit matches EQ's one-aftershock-per-slam exactly + physical-neutral + stun. Minor drift: the aftershock's LARGER radius than the initial hit is a behavioral property carried by the geometry+timing note rather than a separate scaled-geometry field; and physical is element-neutral (flavor only) per the physical rule. A player keeps the slam-then-delayed-bigger-boom rhythm faithfully.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: PLANT-AND-PAYOFF slam: 'slam now, aftershock later — a delayed second larger hit' (mech_note). The two-hit-with-delay identity has a NATIVE lane: ability_grammar timing name='delayed' with delay_seconds (0.5-2.0s uniform, engine-verified ability_grammar.py:551-552) — EQ's sub-second-to-1s aftershock sits inside that range, and the engine's 'one delayed hit, non-stacking' matches EQ's 'one aftershock per slam, no stacking pre-3.25' exactly. Geometry ground_slam (§6 slam/quake). PHYSICAL RULE (§1): physical -> element-neutral, geometry+stun carry identity (probe control lists NO ailment, but a heavy physical slam is the stun archetype; stun is the honest physical-slam ailment — kept minimal). GEOMETRY nuance: the aftershock's larger radius is a behavioral property (the delayed hit covers a wider zone) that ground_slam + the delayed-timing note carries. T4 GEOMETRY_COLLAPSE (the concentrated-slam-zone reading; §5 AoE/geometry warps) — the two-stage same-location detonation is a geometry-warp identity more than a charge engine. CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — t4 routed from core identity (delayed two-stage slam geometry) + probe (physical/rooted/large-zone) per fallback. resource_economy empty: mana-light is the chassis default, no identity-load-bearing deviation (R-M4).
